# Get-ZbxHttpTest

## SYNOPSIS

Gets web scenarios.

## SYNTAX

### All (Default)

```
Get-ZbxHttpTest [-HostReference <ZabbixReference<ZabbixHost>[]>] [-Limit <int>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ById

```
Get-ZbxHttpTest [-Id] <ulong[]> [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

### ByName

```
Get-ZbxHttpTest [[-Name] <string>] [-Limit <int>] [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxHttpTest cmdlet reads web scenarios with httptest.get: all of them, the scenarios on the hosts in -Host, the scenarios with the ids in -Id, or by name with -Name (* and ? are wildcards). Each ZabbixHttpTest carries its steps, interval, authentication and tags. It needs a connection made with Connect-ZbxServer.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Get the web scenarios of a host

```powershell
Get-ZbxHttpTest -Host 'web-01' | Select-Object HttpTestId, Name, Delay, Status
```

-HostReference (alias -Host) takes a host's name, id or object; a host piped from Get-ZbxHost binds by its HostId.

### Example 2: Get a scenario by name and list its steps

```powershell
(Get-ZbxHttpTest -Name 'Web checkout').Steps | Select-Object No, Name, Url, StatusCodes
```

Each step is one request: its order, name, URL and the status codes it expects.
